title: concerning
text:
concerning. I took these out of the package and immediately put them on my bed because I was so excited. I love new sheets and I’ve never actually owned white ones.
Anyway I noticed my lungs tightened up and I felt like I was suffocating and I was coughing... there’s something in these sheets causing a reaction in me which is very disturbing to me as I’m not allergic to anything and I’m not sensitive to things. I started reading more reviews and saw another state she has a terrible allergic reaction. I decided I needed to write a review right away.
I took these off. They made me cough horribly in the process.
I’m highly concerned.
